title: MERN Engineer
descriptionText:
Code District is looking for passionate Software Engineers with 1-3 years of experience to join our growing engineering team. You will work on modern web applications using React/Next.js, Node.js/NestJS, SQL and NoSQL databases, and core AWS cloud services, contributing to scalable, secure, and well-structured systems.

Were an AI-first engineering organization: we want developers who are comfortable using tools like Copilot, Cursor, and LLMs to work smarter, but who also have strong fundamentals and can think independently

Key Responsibilities

Develop, enhance, and maintain web applications using React/Next.js on the frontend and Node.js/NestJS on the backend.
Design, build, and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external services.
Work with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) for data modeling and query optimization.
Use core AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway) for application hosting, storage, and integrations
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following best coding practices and team standards.
Use Git effectively: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and CI-friendly workflows.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and other engineers in an Agile environment.
Participate in code reviews, estimations, and technical discussions.
Proactively improve performance, scalability, and reliability of existing systems.
Use AI-powered tools (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) to speed up development while maintaining high code quality.

Requirements

1-3 years of professional experience in web application development.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+); familiarity with TypeScript is a plus.
Hands-on experience with React (Next.js preferred) and Node.js (NestJS is a plus).
Strong foundation in SQL databases; experience with MongoDB/NoSQL is preferred.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Good understanding of version control (Git) and modern development workflows.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms, especially core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, etc.).
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
Disciplined, reliable, and highly committed to delivering on responsibilities and timelines.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new technologies and tools.
Preferably experienced with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor, etc.) and exposure to public LLMs (OpenAI, etc.)
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

title: Software Engineer - Backend .Net
descriptionText:
We're seeking passionate, driven, and self-motivated individuals to join our team. If you're eager to grow in a dynamic environment and be part of a company that’s at the forefront of AI innovation, this is your chance to hit the ground running.

VIDIZMO is a USA-based technology company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, and a Microsoft Solutions Partner in Data & AI, Infrastructure, and Digital & App Innovation. Offering a AI-Powered Intelligence Hub, we empower Fortune 500 companies, large enterprises, governments, and the public sector to securely manage, analyze, and govern their data with complete control and compliance.

Our Multimodal AI Data Intelligence Platform leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to deliver powerful capabilities such as auto-tagging, redaction, content summarization, OCR, translation, subtitle creation, object detection and tracking, content search, sentiment and emotion analysis, topic extraction, document classification, and facial attribute detection.

AI Output Verification & Accountability (Required Competency)

The candidate must be capable of effectively using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to support work outputs such as content, analysis, documentation, or code. However, the candidate must also demonstrate strong judgment and ownership of the final deliverables. AI-generated output must never be treated as final without review. The candidate is expected to validate accuracy, completeness, logic, compliance, and alignment with business requirements, and refine AI-assisted work to meet the expected quality standards. The individual will be held accountable for the final output, regardless of whether AI tools were used during execution.

Responsibilities:

Build server-side web technology stack that provides API for various products and integrations
Responsibility for reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs
Ownership of final deliverables, regardless of AI assistance
Ability to critically evaluate AI results and ensure they meet defined requirements
Accountability for accuracy, quality, and compliance

Develop and enhance back-end processing pipeline with evolving needs
Work with Product Analyst, Web Engineers, and other Front and Back end engineers to provide necessary support building new features
Securing and ensuring the back-end stack is scalable, elastic and can support millions of concurrent users
Perform unit, integration testing of developed modules and systems as well as participate in weekly bug bash activity
Perform Peer code reviews to improve code quality
Follow and enforce SCRUM/Agile practices as well as work with Product Manager, maintaining product and spring backlog
Propose and participate in the adoption of new technologies and trends

Essential Skills:

Must have worked with at least one server-side technology for developing web application such as ASP.NET OR C# OR Java Spring/Spring Boot OR NodeJS OR Python
Have experience developing and designing API and Middle-ware for the web
Hands on experience working on Visual Studio 2019, SQL Server Management Studio
Proficient knowledge and in-depth understanding of underlying frameworks like .NET, Java, etc.
Have experience and knowledge of designing scalable application
Skilled in implementing design patterns and logic development
The ideal candidate demonstrates strong business acumen, translates objectives into impactful solutions, and effectively leverages AI tools for efficiency. Proficiency in Claude (mandatory) and familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT are required. An ownership mindset and the ability to deliver results independently are essential. Successful completion of a Claude-based assessment is required as part of the hiring process.

Preferred Skills:

Have created an application using ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET 5, libraries in .NET and Windows services
Have worked on SignalR OR gRPC OR WebSockets
Have worked with Azure Devops OR AWS OR Google PaaS Services
Have done system-level programming such as sockets, multi-threading, or designed distributed applications
Have worked on video streaming technology or encoders/decoders
Containers, Elastic Search, Dapper, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Zipkin, Consul, Zookeeper, Redis, WSL/2, gRPC protocols, mDNS

Required Qualification:

BS/BSc or above in Computer Science
0 - 5+ years experience in backend development
Can work independently and have a go-getter attitude
Good English language verbal and writing communication skills
Authorized to work legally

Benefits: Health Insurance (OPD/IPD), Daily Lunch Facility, Separate Maternity Cover, Leave encashment, Car Support Program, Referral Bonus, EOBI, Bi-Annual Increment. Provident Fund, Career Growth, Bonus (benefits vary based on location)

Multiple Locations: Pakistan, India, UAE, Australia, Canada & USA

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
descriptionText:
About DigiU

At DigiU, we build next-gen digital products and platforms for businesses looking to scale smart and fast. We’re on the lookout for a Full Stack Software Engineer who’s passionate about crafting elegant code, solving real-world problems, and working on everything from backend APIs to frontend interfaces.

Role Overview

As a Full Stack Developer, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust backend services and sleek frontend interfaces. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions with high performance and reliability.

Key Responsibilities Backend Development

Design and build scalable backend services using Python (Django / FastAPI) and Node.js
Develop and maintain REST APIs and support third-party API integrations
Use tools like Postman for testing and debugging APIs
Ensure backend performance, security, and data integrity

Frontend Development

Build intuitive and responsive user interfaces using React.js
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to bring mockups to life
Optimize front-end performance across devices and browsers

General Responsibilities

Participate in the full software development lifecycle: planning, coding, testing, deployment, and support
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Debug and resolve issues across the stack
Work in an agile, fast-paced environment and contribute to sprint planning and reviews
Collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams

Required Skills & Experience

2–5 years of hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer
Strong experience with:
Backend: Python, Django, FastAPI, Node.js, REST APIs, API integrations
Frontend: React.js
Tools: Postman, Git
Solid understanding of web application architecture, security, and scalability
Experience working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL)

Nice to Have

Familiarity with containerization (Docker)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Knowledge of modern development workflows and tools (Jira, GitHub, etc.)
Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, etc.)

Soft Skills

Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
Excellent communication and teamwork skills
Self-driven and capable of working independently and collaboratively
A learning mindset and openness to feedback

PHP Developer

1. Our culture is challenging and goal oriented. If you feel most alive when you generate results that many would say are impossible, then you will be a star here!!

2. We have increased our engineering headcount by over 55% in the last 6 months! We believe that our engineering team is the heart of our organization and is what we need to focus on to be successful and competitive!

· PHP

· Laravel, Symphony, CakePHP (or any MVC framework)

· MySQL

· Linux

· jQuery What's In It for You

· Good salary package

· Paid Vacations

· Remote work perks when needed What are you waiting for? If you are looking for a stable job, good mentorship and a company where you can grow, let's talk!

title: Senior Conversational AI Engineer - Google
descriptionText:
Ontrac Solutions is a leading technology consulting firm specializing in cutting-edge solutions that drive business transformation. We partner with organizations to modernize their infrastructure, streamline processes, and deliver tangible results.

Our client is actively seeking a Conversational AI Engineer with deep hands-on experience in Google Contact Center AI (CCAI) to join a high-impact digital transformation project via a GCP Premier Partner. As part of a staff augmentation model, you will be embedded within the client's technology or contact center innovation team, delivering scalable virtual agent solutions that improve customer experience, agent productivity, and call deflection.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the design and buildout of Dialogflow CX/ES agents across chat and voice channels.

Integrate virtual agents with client systems and platforms (e.g., Genesys, Twilio, NICE CXone, Salesforce).

Develop fulfillment logic using Google Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and backend integrations (via REST APIs and webhooks).

Collaborate with stakeholders to define intent models, entity schemas, and user flows.

Implement Agent Assist and CCAI Insights to augment live agent productivity.

Leverage Google Cloud tools including Pub/Sub, Logging, and BigQuery to support and monitor the solution.

Support tuning, regression testing, and enhancement of NLP performance using live utterance data.

Ensure adherence to enterprise security and compliance requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

3+ years developing conversational AI experiences, including at least 1–2 years with Google Dialogflow CX or ES.

Solid experience across GCP services (Functions, Cloud Run, IAM, BigQuery, etc.).

Strong skills in Python or Node.js for webhook fulfillment and backend logic.

Knowledge of NLU/NLP modeling, training, and performance tuning.

Prior experience working in client-facing or embedded roles via consulting or staff augmentation.

Ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

Hands-on experience with Agent Assist, CCAI Insights, or third-party CCaaS tools (Genesys, Twilio Flex, NICE CXone).

Familiarity with Vertex AI, AutoML, or other GCP ML services.

Experience in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance, etc.).

Google Cloud certification in Cloud Developer or CCAI Engineer.

title: Backend Engineer
descriptionText:
The Backend Engineer at Venturenox is responsible for creating microservices, establishing inter-services communications and building APIs. Primary platforms to be used are NodeJS (Express), Python (FastAPI), Kafka, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

Location: Lahore

Work Mode: Hybrid with 2 days/week in office

Experience: 1 - 2 years

Responsibilities:

Develop server side logic and REST APIs and collaborate with cloud engineers to make the code suitable for deployment in cloud-native environments.

Develop database entity relationships and structures for every micro-service.

Develop sagas which represent event driven architecture and flow of information between microservices.

Desired Skills:

Understanding and experience with NodeJS (Express) and Python (FastAPI).

Experience with using PostgreSQL along with solid concepts of SQL and ORM.

Experience with any NoSQL database such as MongoDB

Understanding of micro-services architecture and familiarity with API gateways is highly desirable. Familiarity with Kafka is also highly desirable.

title: ML/AI Engineer
descriptionText:
*Please note this is full-time remote position for committed and dedicated resource, who will be working from 12PM to 9PM. Monday to Friday. *

KIDAN is more than a family-owned and multi-cultural international IT consultancy firm. We've grown from a single client to a family of over 900+ enterprises worldwide, cementing ourselves as trusted IT management and security advisors.

Our strength lies in our proactive problem-solving approach. By asking the right questions and strategizing effective solutions, we've consistently delivered secure, reliable IT systems, leaving a trail of success stories in our wake. Our talented team of experts is the driving force behind these achievements.

We are seeking a highly skilled *AI & ML Engineer* to architect, build, and deploy our secure internal *AI platform*. This platform will act as a centralized intelligence layer supporting *security, directory services, internal data, workflows, *and *organizational automation*.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in *AI/ML engineering, LLMs, IAM, enterprise security, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations*, with a proven track record in training and fine‑tuning *large language models*.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Build and maintain an internal AI platform for centralized organizational data, knowledge, and security.
* Develop custom LLM-based tools for internal use (chatbots, automation agents, access‑control intelligence, internal search, compliance & policy monitoring).
* Train and fine‑tune LLMs on internal datasets with strict security and privacy standards.
* Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using vector databases.
* Automate internal workflows (referral requests, onboarding, compliance alerts, CRM updates, IAM tasks).
* Build secure APIs and backend services enabling AI-driven operations and system integrations.
* Deploy, monitor, scale, and optimize ML/LLM models in cloud or hybrid environments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, Security, Ops) to integrate AI into existing internal systems.

*Requirements*

* *4+ years *of hands‑on experience in *Machine Learning*.
* Strong expertise in *Python* and *ML frameworks *(TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑learn).
* Proven experience training, fine‑tuning, optimizing, and deploying *LLMs*.
* Experience with *RAG pipelines* and vector databases.
* Solid understanding of *Identity & Access Management (IAM)* and enterprise security principles.
* Strong experience building *APIs, backend services*, and integrating ML models into production systems.
* *Cloud deployment experience *(AWS, Azure, GCP) for model hosting, scaling, and security.
* Strong foundation in data pipelines, ML operations, and model optimization.
* Full-time remote job
* 8 hours per day from 11 AM to 8 PM PST (Monday to Friday)

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs150,000.00 - Rs200,000.00 per month

* Kindly let us know what is your Salary expectation for this full-time remote position?

title: Software Engineer
descriptionText:
About us

WallStreetBets is the largest finance community in the world.

With over 20 million users, we’re the movement that helped redefine retail investing and put power back into the hands of everyday traders. From our humble beginnings on Reddit to becoming a global household name during the GameStop saga, our influence has shaped markets, culture, and the future of finance.

And we’re just getting started.

Today, our mission is stronger than ever: minimize the gap between retail and institutions by giving people access to world-class tools, real-time data, community intelligence, and a platform built for the next generation of traders. Our goal? Accelerate one billion people to financial security, and have fun doing it.

Position summary

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build the core infrastructure behind the new WallStreetBets platform, powering real-time data, earnings call insights, social sentiment, community feeds, and trader-focused tools.

You'll work across the stack to ship high-performance, scalable features used by millions of traders. From backend services and APIs to front-end components and data-driven experiences, you’ll play a key role in defining the engineering foundation of a globally recognized fintech product.

This is an opportunity to join early, move fast, and build something that truly impacts how retail traders interact with markets. This role is open to applicants anywhere in the world and will be hired as a contractor. At WallStreetBets, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where all voices are heard.

If building the future of social finance with speed, creativity, and WSB swagger sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to meet you.

What you’ll do:

Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.

Develop responsive, high-quality web features using modern frontend frameworks.

Work with real-time financial data, websockets, event-driven systems, and market APIs.

Build community-driven experiences such as feeds, notifications, and sentiment tools.

Implement dashboards and interfaces that make financial data clear and accessible.

Collaborate closely with product, design, and mobile teams to deliver features quickly.

Improve overall system performance, reliability, testing, and automation.

Participate in architectural planning and long-term technical decision-making.

What you bring:

5+ years of software engineering experience in a full stack or backend-focused role.

Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, or Java.

Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Svelte.

Strong understanding of RESTful or GraphQL API design and integration.

Comfort working with relational or NoSQL databases.

Familiarity with cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, and modern testing practices (TDD, automated tests).

Confidence developing with modern application security best practices

A strong sense of ownership, product thinking, and comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment.

Collaborative mindset, and the ability to work with a globally distributed team

Bonus

Exposure to fintech, trading, or data-heavy applications.

Experience with websockets, real-time systems, or event-driven architecture.

Familiarity with financial data providers or market data APIs.

Open-source contributions or experience building social or community-driven platforms.

Experience with common compliance frameworks (SOC2, PCI DSS, GDRP)

What we offer

The opportunity to build a platform used by millions of passionate traders around the world.

A mission-driven environment dedicated to democratizing financial tools and insights.

A remote-friendly culture with flexibility and trust.

Competitive compensation and meaningful growth opportunities.

A chance to help shape one of the most recognizable brands in modern finance.

A collaborative, fast-paced team that values experimentation, creativity, and fu

descriptionText:
*Job Title: Junior Backend Engineer (Node.js + FastAPI)*

*Experience:* 1 – 1.5 Years
*Location:* Bahria Town Lahore
*Company:* LAB23 Technologies

*About LAB23 Technologies*

LAB23 Technologies is an AI-driven product development company building scalable SaaS platforms and AI Agents across E-commerce (Zanderio AI), Real Estate, FinTech, and Energy Systems.

We specialize in designing intelligent backend systems that power AI agents, automation workflows, predictive engines, and conversational systems.

We are looking for a driven *Junior Backend Engineer* who is comfortable working with both *Node.js and Python (FastAPI)* and is eager to contribute to AI-powered system architecture.

*Role Overview*

As a Junior Backend Engineer, you will:

* Build scalable backend systems
* Work on AI Agent workflows and orchestration
* Handle complex data structures and system logic
* Contribute to multi-language backend architecture (Node.js + FastAPI)

This role is ideal for someone who understands backend fundamentals deeply and wants exposure to AI infrastructure and intelligent systems.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Develop and maintain backend services using *Node.js*
* Build lightweight AI-related microservices using *Python (FastAPI)*
* Design scalable RESTful APIs for SaaS and AI-driven applications
* Work on AI Agent workflows (state management, memory, orchestration)
* Manage structured and unstructured data pipelines
* Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) with backend systems
* Optimize backend performance and ensure production stability
* Contribute to backend architecture planning and documentation
* Debug and resolve system-level issues in staging/production
* Collaborate with AI Engineers and Frontend teams

*Technical Requirements*
*Must Have:*

* 1 – 1.5 years of backend experience
* Strong proficiency in *Node.js*
* Good working knowledge of *Python*
* Experience building APIs using:
* Express.js / Node frameworks
* FastAPI (or similar Python framework)
* Strong understanding of:
* Async programming
* Middleware architecture
* JWT authentication
* API security best practices
* Experience with databases:
* MongoDB (preferred)
* OR PostgreSQL / MySQL
* Understanding of system design basics
* Experience with Git and version control

*Good to Have:*

* Experience integrating AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
* Understanding of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
* Knowledge of Redis / caching
* Experience with Docker
* Exposure to microservices architecture
* Experience building SaaS backend systems

*What We’re Looking For*

* Strong logical and analytical mindset
* Ability to understand complex workflows
* Comfort working with data-heavy systems
* Clean coding standards and modular design approach
* Ownership mentality
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment

*Growth Opportunity*

*At LAB23, you will:*

* Work on real AI Agent systems
* Contribute to scalable SaaS platforms
* Learn advanced backend and system architecture
* Gain hands-on exposure to AI integrations
* Grow into Mid-Level Backend or AI Systems Engineer

*High performers can move toward:*

* AI Backend Specialist
* System Architect
* Technical Lead (Long-term path)

*Compensation*

Competitive salary based on skill and performance.
Performance-based growth opportunities available.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From Rs50,000.00 per month



Ability to commute/relocate:
* Lahore: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Company: LAB23 Technologies

About LAB23 Technologies

LAB23 Technologies is an AI-driven product development company building scalable SaaS platforms and AI Agents across E-commerce (Zanderio AI), Real Estate, FinTech, and Energy Systems.

We specialize in designing intelligent backend systems that power AI agents, automation workflows, predictive engines, and conversational systems.

We are looking for a driven Junior Backend Engineer who is comfortable working with both Node.js and Python (FastAPI) and is eager to contribute to AI-powered system architecture.

Role Overview

As a Junior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build scalable backend systems
  • Work on AI Agent workflows and orchestration
  • Handle complex data structures and system logic
  • Contribute to multi-language backend architecture (Node.js + FastAPI)

This role is ideal for someone who understands backend fundamentals deeply and wants exposure to AI infrastructure and intelligent systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js
  • Build lightweight AI-related microservices using Python (FastAPI)
  • Design scalable RESTful APIs for SaaS and AI-driven applications
  • Work on AI Agent workflows (state management, memory, orchestration)
  • Manage structured and unstructured data pipelines
  • Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) with backend systems
  • Optimize backend performance and ensure production stability
  • Contribute to backend architecture planning and documentation
  • Debug and resolve system-level issues in staging/production
  • Collaborate with AI Engineers and Frontend teams

Technical Requirements
Must Have:

  • 1 – 1.5 years of backend experience
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js
  • Good working knowledge of Python
  • Experience building APIs using:
  • Express.js / Node frameworks
  • FastAPI (or similar Python framework)
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Async programming
  • Middleware architecture
  • JWT authentication
  • API security best practices
  • Experience with databases:
  • MongoDB (preferred)
  • OR PostgreSQL / MySQL
  • Understanding of system design basics
  • Experience with Git and version control

Good to Have:

  • Experience integrating AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
  • Understanding of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Redis / caching
  • Experience with Docker
  • Exposure to microservices architecture
  • Experience building SaaS backend systems

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong logical and analytical mindset
  • Ability to understand complex workflows
  • Comfort working with data-heavy systems
  • Clean coding standards and modular design approach
  • Ownership mentality
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment

Growth Opportunity

At LAB23, you will:

  • Work on real AI Agent systems
  • Contribute to scalable SaaS platforms
  • Learn advanced backend and system architecture
  • Gain hands-on exposure to AI integrations
  • Grow into Mid-Level Backend or AI Systems Engineer

High performers can move toward:

  • AI Backend Specialist
  • System Architect
  • Technical Lead (Long-term path)

Compensation

Competitive salary based on skill and performance.
Performance-based growth opportunities available.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From Rs50,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

  • Lahore: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
descriptionText:
*Job Summary*

We are looking for a *hands-on AI Engineer* with *at least 2 years of professional experience* in building *AI agents and automated AI-driven workflows*. The ideal candidate should have strong experience working with *LLMs, AI agent frameworks, and n8n workflow automation*, and be capable of integrating intelligent systems into real-world business applications.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design, develop, and deploy *AI agents* capable of task execution, decision-making, and tool usage
* Build and maintain *n8n workflows* for AI-driven automation
* Integrate AI agents with:
* Internal systems (ERP, CRM, databases)
* Third-party APIs and services
* Develop *LLM-powered solutions* such as chatbots, assistants, and process automation tools
* Implement *prompt engineering*, agent memory, and multi-step reasoning flows
* Build and consume *REST APIs* for AI integrations
* Monitor, debug, and optimize AI agents and automation workflows
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of AI systems
* Document AI workflows, agent logic, and integrations

*Required Skills & QualificationsExperience*

* Minimum *2 years of professional experience* as an AI Engineer / ML Engineer / Automation Engineer

*Core Technical Skills*

* Strong proficiency in *Python*
* Experience with *NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn*
* Solid understanding of *data handling, statistics, and ML fundamentals*

*AI, LLMs & Agents*

* Hands-on experience building *AI agents*
* Experience working with *LLMs* (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, etc.)
* Strong *prompt engineering* skills
* Experience with *RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)* pipelines
* Familiarity with agent frameworks such as:
* *LangChain*
* *LlamaIndex*
* or similar tools

*Automation & Workflows*

* Proven experience working with *n8n workflow automation*
* Experience building:
* Event-driven workflows
* Webhook-based automations
* Scheduled (cron) workflows
* Ability to orchestrate workflows involving *LLMs + APIs + databases*

*APIs & Backend*

* Experience building and consuming *REST APIs*
* Familiarity with *FastAPI or Flask*
* Experience integrating AI systems with databases (SQL / NoSQL)

*Nice to Have (Plus Points)*

* Experience with *self-hosted n8n deployments*
* Knowledge of *vector databases* (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
* Experience with *Docker* and basic cloud deployments
* Familiarity with *MLOps concepts*
* Experience with *Zapier / Make.com* in addition to n8n

*Soft Skills*

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Self-driven and eager to learn new technologies

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs55,000.00 - Rs75,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
